name: payment-collection-system
description: Payment Collection Management System — dealer/employee collection tracking with real-time balance updates

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && (./.venv/bin/uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000 || python3 -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000)
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run typecheck
scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && python3 -m venv .venv && ./.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && ./.venv/bin/python seed.py
